description: This file defines the VerhoeffIdentifierValidator class, which validates identifiers using the Verhoeff checksum algorithm. It extends a base hyphenated identifier validator and implements logic specific to Verhoeff checksum computation and validation.

classes.name: VerhoeffIdentifierValidator
classes.description: Validator class for verifying identifiers using the Verhoeff checksum algorithm.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Returns the allowed characters for the identifier, which are digits 0-9.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator.

methods.name: getCheckDigit
methods.description: Calculates and returns the check digit for a given undecorated identifier.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the identifier, ensuring it adheres to Verhoeff rules and custom conditions.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Constructs a valid identifier, ensuring correct length and checksum.

methods.name: getBase
methods.description: Extracts digits from a number into an array for Verhoeff processing.

methods.name: insertCheck
methods.description: Calculates and inserts the Verhoeff check digit into the identifier's digit array.

methods.name: VerhoeffIdentifierValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing lookup tables for Verhoeff checksum calculation.
